name: The Wedding
source:
You are at your best friend's dinner rehearsal and you are not very happy about her decisions, so you start to drink a little too much until his brother shows up just to piss you off even more

[From [url=https://pofitoo.itch.io/the-wedding]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在参加最好的朋友的婚礼彩排晚宴，却对她的决定很不满，于是开始喝得有些过量。直到她的哥哥出现，进一步惹恼了你。

[摘自[url=https://pofitoo.itch.io/the-wedding]Itch.io[/url]]
